name: Berry Phase Constraint via cvc5

pytorch.reason: Berry phase is geometric/topological constraint; no gradient descent on constraint equation

pyg.reason: Berry phase on state space loop; not a graph message passing problem

z3.reason: cvc5 preferred for real arithmetic and range constraints [0, 2π)

cvc5.reason: cvc5 enforces γ ∈ ℝ, γ ∈ [0,2π), gauge-invariance via QF_NRA real arithmetic constraints

sympy.reason: sympy derives Pancharatnam connection (1-form) and parallel transport on quantum state manifold

clifford.reason: Berry phase relates to spin geometry; topological constraint solved before spinor representation

e3nn.reason: Berry phase is scalar geometric invariant; no equivariant network required

rustworkx.reason: Berry phase on closed loop in parameter space; not a graph combinatorics problem

test_positive_trivial_loop.description: cvc5 SAT: trivial loop (adiabatic return) gives Berry phase γ = 0

test_positive_moebius_loop.description: cvc5 SAT: Möbius loop gives nontrivial Berry phase γ = π

test_positive_intermediate_phase.description: cvc5 SAT: arbitrary phase γ = π/2 within range [0, 2π)

test_negative_phase_out_of_range.description: cvc5 UNSAT: Berry phase must lie in [0, 2π); violation with γ = 3π

test_negative_path_dependent_phase.description: cvc5 UNSAT: Berry phase gauge-invariance forbids path-dependence

test_negative_complex_phase.description: cvc5 UNSAT: Berry phase is real-valued; nonzero imaginary part impossible

test_boundary_near_2pi.description: cvc5 SAT: Berry phase near 2π boundary γ ≈ 6.183 (just below 2π)

test_boundary_pancharatnam_connection.description: sympy: Pancharatnam connection A(t) = i⟨ψ|∂ψ⟩ governs Berry phase γ = ∮ A·dR
test_boundary_pancharatnam_connection.phase_integral: γ = ∮ A·dR (line integral of 1-form on closed path)
test_boundary_pancharatnam_connection.gauge_invariance: γ independent of |ψ⟩ → e^{iφ(R)}|ψ⟩ (global U(1) redundancy)
test_boundary_pancharatnam_connection.topological: γ depends only on homotopy class of loop, not smooth deformation

test_boundary_parallel_transport.description: sympy: Parallel transport on quantum state manifold encodes Berry holonomy
test_boundary_parallel_transport.topology: holonomy is topological (depends on homotopy class, not smooth variation)
